wfin.title: Wall finishes
wfin.pick: Pick a wall to put a finish on its face.
wfin.curved: A curved wall cannot take a finish yet.
wfin.face.note: Left and right as seen going from the wall's start to its end.
wfin.nozones: The face is raw: no finish yet.
wfin.add.notypes: Make a finish type first (Finish types tab).
finishes.err.face: Pick the left or the right face.
finishes.err.curved: A curved wall cannot take a finish yet.
finishes.err.emptyzone: The zone has no size: the two corners are on one line.
finishes.err.corners: Give two opposite corners, or all four.
finishes.err.notrect: The four corners must make a rectangle with sides along the wall and up.
finishes.err.typeused: A finish still uses this type. Remove those finishes first.
finishes.err.nozone: That finish is not on the face any more.
finishes.err.zone.span: The zone must end after it starts.
finishes.err.zone.height: The zone must end above where it starts.
finishes.err.type.name: Give the type a name.
finishes.err.type.layers: A finish type needs at least one layer.
finishes.err.layer: A layer needs a thickness of 0 or more.
finishes.err.tile: A tile needs a length, a width, a joint of 0 to 50 mm and a waste of 0 to 100 percent.
wfin.edge.left: Tile ends at its low edge
wfin.edge.right: Tile starts at its high edge
wfin.opening.none: No door or window in this wall.
wfin.shift: Brick shift (0 to 1 of a tile)
wfin.count.est: About {order} to order (counted from the area)
wfin.type.name: Name
wfin.sub.lede: What each finish type is laid on, with its material and thickness. The finished size of a wall is read from these.
wfin.finished: Finished wall: {raw} raw, {left} on the left face, {right} on the right face, {total} finished.
wfin.rule: A finish is measured on the face of its wall: its rectangle, less any finish laid over it and less every door and window cut through it. Volumes are net area times each layer's thickness. Tiles are counted from the set-out: a tile cut by the edge, an opening or a finish laid over it is a cut tile, and every cut tile is counted as a new one.
wfin.rule.estimated: A figure marked ≈ was counted from the area, not tile by tile.
wfin.none: No finishes on any wall yet.
